definitions.explanation: The act of sampling food, typically free samples offered at stores or events.

examples.japanese: スーパーで{試食|ししょく}をした。
examples.english: I tried some samples at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: {試食|ししょく}コーナーで{新商品|しんしょうひん}を{食|た}べてみた。
examples.english: I tried the new product at the tasting corner.

examples.japanese: {試食|ししょく}は{無料|むりょう}です。どうぞお{試|ため}しください。
examples.english: The samples are free. Please try some.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいケーキの{試食|ししょく}{会|かい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A tasting event for the new cake was held.

examples.japanese: {試食|ししょく}してみたら{美味|おい}しかったので、つい{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: I tried a sample and it was so good that I ended up buying it.

notes:
{試食|ししょく} combines {試|し} (try) + {食|しょく} (eat).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {試食|ししょく}する (to sample food)
- {試食|ししょく}コーナー (tasting corner)
- {試食|ししょく}{品|ひん} (sample food)
- {試食|ししょく}{会|かい} (tasting event)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {試飲|しいん} (drink sampling)
- {試着|しちゃく} (trying on clothes)
- {試乗|しじょう} (test drive)
- {試用|しよう} (trial use)

USAGE NOTES:
- Very common in Japanese supermarkets and department stores
- Often offered on weekends and holidays to promote products
